headline: Pakistan's KSE-100 Drops Over 500 Points in Early Trade on Broad Selling
summary: The benchmark KSE-100 index shed 559.42 points, or 0.32%, to hover at 176,212.76 in opening trading at the Pakistan Stock Exchange, led by losses across autos, cement, and energy.
why: The KSE-100 is Pakistan's benchmark equity index, sensitive to domestic macro conditions and international emerging market capital allocations.

impacts.name: KSE-100 Index
impacts.why: The Pakistani stock benchmark shed more than 500 points in early Friday trading.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Early selling pressure across auto, oil and gas, and power exploration sectors pulled Pakistan's benchmark index lower.
